extraction.name: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
extraction.description: A dataset of 7,787 natural, grade-school science questions partitioned into a Challenge Set (2,590 questions answered incorrectly by simple baselines) and an Easy Set (5,197 questions), designed to encourage AI research in advanced question answering requiring reasoning and knowledge beyond surface-level cues.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of 7,787 natural science questions authored for standardized tests, collected through several months of extensive search and investigation. The questions were partitioned into a Challenge Set (2,590 questions) containing questions answered incorrectly by both retrieval-based and word co-occurrence algorithms, and an Easy Set (5,197 questions) containing the remainder. An ARC Corpus of 14M science-related sentences with relevant knowledge was also assembled.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Natural science questions from standardized tests and examination boards, along with science-related sentences for the corpus. Question sources are described in Table 7 (Appendix A).
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Information Retrieval (IR) Solver and Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) Solver were used to partition questions into Challenge Set and Easy Set based on whether both algorithms answered incorrectly
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset focuses on natural science questions from standardized tests, which may limit generalization to other domains. Questions are partitioned into Challenge and Easy sets based on performance of retrieval and word co-occurrence algorithms, which may introduce selection bias.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for training and evaluating AI systems on advanced question answering tasks that require reasoning, commonsense knowledge, and deeper text comprehension beyond simple retrieval methods.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is publicly available through the ARC Website with a leaderboard for tracking submissions and progress.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The ARC Dataset is partitioned into a Challenge Set (2590 questions) containing questions answered incorrectly by both a retrieval-based algorithm and a word co-occurrence algorithm, and an Easy Set (5197 questions) containing the remainder.
